name: YouTube to Text — Video Transcript & Summary
description: Instant transcript, AI transcript and summary of any YouTube video — right on the page. No sign-up, any language. by skribr.
_comment: Two content scripts + a background service worker. The MAIN-world script (document_start) reads window.ytInitialPlayerResponse (the isolated world cannot see it) and forwards videoId to ISOLATED via postMessage(__skribr) for SPA video-change detection. The ISOLATED-world script (content.js) renders the panel in #secondary. ВСЕ сетевые запросы (transcript + distill) идут через background.js: в MV3 cross-origin fetch из content-script режется CORS (host_permissions его не обходят), а из service worker — разрешён. UI brand: "YouTube to Text · by skribr". The esbuild build copies this file into dist/ with flat js paths → Load unpacked: apps/extension/dist.
